chen2026pcm_bwcm: Riemannian metrics on Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifolds typically rely on eigendecomposition or matrix square roots, incurring high computational overhead and gradient instability under nearly degenerate spectra. We propose the Power-Cholesky Metric (PCM) and Bures-Wasserstein-Cholesky Metric (BWCM) by equipping the Cholesky space with a product geometry separating the strictly lower triangular part and positive diagonal part. Both metrics yield closed-form distance, geodesic, Fréchet mean, logarithmic, and exponential maps using only Cholesky factorization, while BWCM recovers exact Bures-Wasserstein geometry on diagonal SPD matrices.
hu2025coratt: Correlation matrices live on the quotient/submanifold of full-rank SPD matrices with unit diagonal. Existing SPD attention mechanisms distort unit-diagonal invariance when applied to correlation connectivity. We propose CorAtt, a Riemannian self-attention network over the full-rank correlation manifold leveraging Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM) diffeomorphisms to hollow symmetric tangent spaces, enabling geometry-preserving Q/K/V transformations and correlation barycenter aggregation for EEG decoding.
chen2026cornet: Full-rank correlation matrices provide scale-invariant functional connectivity representations in neuroimaging. We develop Riemannian neural networks over the correlation manifold (CorNet) under quotient and pullback metrics (OLM and LSM), preserving unit-diagonal positive definiteness across deep bilinear and non-linear transformations.
chen2026rietrans: We formulate a general framework for Riemannian Multinomial Logistic Regression (SPDRMLR) and intrinsic SPD Fully-Connected Transformation layers (SPDLinear) across deformed SPD geometries (LEM, LCM, AIM, PEM). By mapping multi-channel SPD inputs through unidirectional Riemannian hyperplanes into symmetric tangent coordinates and exponentiating only when manifold outputs are required, chained SPDLinear layers eliminate redundant intermediate eigendecompositions.
wang2025gyroatt: We introduce a general attention framework on gyrovector spaces for matrix manifolds (GyroAtt). On SPD manifolds, GyroSPDAttention transforms queries, keys, and values via orthogonal gyro-automorphisms parameterized by Cayley maps, aggregates values via gyro-barycenters, and applies left gyro-translation biases, while SymSPDAttention performs intrinsic SPDLinear projections in tangent space.
ju2023graphcspnet: Graph-CSPNet models multi-band, multi-window EEG covariance trajectories as a graph on the SPD manifold. GraphBiMap aggregates neighboring time-frequency SPD matrices via a graph propagation matrix before applying node-wise bilinear congruences, capturing non-stationary time-frequency dynamics in motor imagery BCI.
zhou2026gbwatt: Existing manifold attention decoders such as MAtt rely on Log-Euclidean geometry, where logarithmic eigenvalue compression amplifies noise in small eigenvalues of ill-conditioned EEG covariance matrices. We propose GBWAtt based on Generalized (2theta, M)-Bures-Wasserstein geometry with a learnable SPD reference matrix M and power deformation theta, achieving closed-form Wasserstein barycentric attention aggregation and stable gradients on ill-conditioned spectra.
seraphim2023spdtransnet: Standard multi-head attention applies linear value projections and head concatenation that violate symmetric positive definite tangent space structure unless expensive per-head log/exp maps are computed. SPDTransNet introduces Structure-Preserving Multi-Head Attention (SP-MHA), which linearly combines per-head attention probability matrices across heads into a single mixing matrix applied directly to whitened tangent-space SPD tokens.
wang2026spdmetaformer: In manifold attention networks for EEG decoding (such as MAtt and GBWAtt), the bounded similarity function 1/(1 + log(1 + d)) yields nearly uniform softmax attention weights across short patch sequences, while Q/K bilinear projections over-parameterize small-data regimes. SPD-MetaFormer replaces learned Q/K attention with an attention-free uniform Log-Euclidean Fréchet mean token mixer, geodesic residual connections, and a shared spectral feedforward network.
hu2026rhop: Brain Foundation Models and EEG Transformers typically rely on first-order mean pooling or a single CLS token, discarding second-order inter-token covariance statistics. Riemannian High-Order Pooling (RHOP) embeds token mean and covariance into a quotient Gaussian SPD matrix and projects it via Riemannian geometry (LEM, PEM, LCM) to fuse second-order geometric statistics with the Transformer token representation.
ju2024deepgeocca: DeepGeoCCA extends Canonical Correlation Analysis to SPD manifolds for multi-view neuroimaging data. Dual SPDNet encoders map paired views to low-dimensional SPD manifolds and maximize total squared geodesic correlation in the tangent space at the batch Fréchet mean under an epsilon-geodesic regularization constraint.
gallet2026armagnac: Standard Riemannian batch normalization on SPDNet relies on iterative Karcher flow with repeated eigenvalue decompositions. ARMAGNAC introduces a parametric closed-form batch mean that interpolates along the geodesic between the batch Harmonic mean and batch Arithmetic mean via a learnable scalar parameter alpha in (0, 1), automatically adapting to the data geometry while accelerating forward/backward passes.
zhou2025gbwbn_cbn: We introduce Riemannian batch normalization under Bures-Wasserstein geometry (GBWBN) and Cholesky tangent space geometry (CBN) for SPD neural networks, avoiding the numerical instability of affine-invariant Karcher flow on ill-conditioned covariance matrices and eliminating eigendecompositions in Cholesky batch normalization.
tibermacine2025rceegnet: RCEEGNet integrates temporal feature extraction, regularized SPD covariance pooling, multi-stage BiMap/ReEig manifold dimensionality reduction, and 2D geometry-aware convolutional refinement on the symmetric Log-Euclidean tangent matrix for EEG motor imagery classification.
wang2024starnet: STaRNet combines a Riemannian patch-covariance branch with a parallel Euclidean spatio-temporal squeeze-and-excitation branch, fusing geometric spatial covariance features with multi-scale temporal dynamics for motor imagery decoding.
chen2025alem_spdresnet: Adaptive Log-Euclidean Metric (ALEM) introduces learnable positive power and affine spectral deformations to adapt matrix logarithm normalizations to heavy-tailed covariance spectra, while SPDResBlock applies 1D spectral convolutions on log-eigenvalues with Log-Euclidean geodesic residual connections.
nguyen2023gyrospd: GyroSPD constructs deep neural networks on SPD manifolds using gyrovector space operations, combining bilinear Stiefel projections with left gyro-translation biases parameterized on the SPD manifold.
boucherie2026spdnetae_ssgcnet: SPDNet-AE learns compact low-dimensional SPD representations via an SPDNet encoder and transposed bilinear congruence decoder trained with Riemannian geodesic reconstruction loss, strictly preserving positive definiteness unlike Euclidean autoencoders. SSGCNet performs tangent-space k-nearest-neighbor graph attention aggregation over Stiefel-reduced patch covariances.
